item.title: Match Report | York City 4-0 Brackley Town | York City Football Club
item.description: Photo by Tom Poole. York City scored another four goals to defeat Brackley Town at the LNER Community Stadium this afternoon. Hiram Boateng had the first shot of the game inside 4 minutes. His left-footed effort from the edge of the box took a deflection to take it just wide of the post. Alex Hunt was next to shoot from a similar position. His effort also took a deflection to drag the ball wide of the mark. It took just 19 minutes for City to get the breakthrough. item.title: Match Report | Gateshead 3-1 York City | York City Football Club
item.description: York City suffered defeat to the hands of Gateshead in the North East following a 3-1 loss. Joe Grey’s ecstatic run got the game started when his movement gave him room to shoot on his left foot from just inside the box. The effort went just wide of the target. Hiram Boateng collected the ball in the midfield before slipping the ball through to Ollie Pearce, who shot on the bounce but could only watch as his effort went over the bar.
